youtube.description:
A giant crystal fox just fell out of the sky in Hunt For Eggs! The Prism Kitsune only eats Prism eggs: feed it 5 for a Prism Chest with 2X Coins, 2X Training... or a 5% chance at the Prism Blade. Every 30 minutes it walks the map and turns beasts Prism, and every hour a giant Prism Alpha lands for the whole server to fight.

The Prism Kitsune leaves this Friday! Play Hunt For Eggs today: link in bio.
